# nddev-opennetwork-design-tokens — Rust

A `no_std` crate with no dependencies for native desktop interfaces (egui, iced, Slint), image rendering and tools. Every set is a `static`; resolving allocates nothing.

```rust
use nddev_opennetwork_design_system::{Colors, Direction, Metrics, Platform, Density, Theme, TextStyle, TypeRole, Script};

let colors = Colors::resolve(Theme::Dark, Direction::On);
let metrics = Metrics::resolve(Platform::Desktop, Density::Comfortable);
let h1 = TextStyle::resolve(TypeRole::H1, Platform::Desktop, Script::Latin);
let [r, g, b, a] = colors.accent_text.to_f32();
let arrow = Icon::Arrow.vector(); // SVG path data per shape, for kurbo, lyon or usvg
```

```toml
[dependencies]
nddev-opennetwork-design-tokens = { path = "third_party/nddev-opennetwork-design-tokens", features = ["fonts"] }
```

The `fonts` feature adds `font_files::ALL`: the TTF bytes of IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic (OFL-1.1) for renderers that load fonts from memory.
